fields.Name: IT52 - Unified Search Seams
fields.Description: Unified search seams: EntityByName contract, SearchEntity lexical ranking incl. exact-name hit, batch SearchEntities alignment, scope permission resolution against real metadata. Client transport. PARKED (requiresEnv RUN_SEARCH_TESTS, unset in CI → reports Skipped): this client bundle previously skip-as-passed and never actually executed in CI; the first real run (MJAPI now booted) showed SR2/SR3 fail because the deterministic host lane has no configured lexical search provider, so SearchEntity returns empty. The check's own 'loud skip when unconfigured' guard did not trigger. Un-gate once the host lane provisions a search provider or the bundle's unconfigured-detection is fixed.
